text: {"lessons":["I should not sell a stock just because it is showing a gain or hold it just to avoid admitting a loss; average cost is not a reason to trade.","I should judge each position by its prospects and its role in my overall portfolio, rather than treating it as a separate account.","Since I trade and check in infrequently, I should set clear review and rebalancing rules instead of reacting to short-term price changes."]}
